units.source_text: 我从东舞鹤中学中途退学后，听从田山道诠和尚的劝说，

en.t: After I withdrew partway through from East Maizuru Middle School, I followed the advice of the priest Tayama Dosen,

units.source_text: 转学到了临济学院中学，再过不足一月就将开始秋季学期，

en.t: and transferred to Rinzai Academy Middle School, where the autumn term would begin in less than a month,

units.source_text: 转校后我得每天走读了。

en.t: and after transferring I would have to commute to school every day.

units.source_text: 但我知道学校一开学，同学们都会立即被分配到某一工厂，参加义务劳动。

en.t: But I knew that as soon as school began, all the students would immediately be assigned to some factory to take part in compulsory labor service.

units.source_text: 现在，在我面前的新环境中，只剩下数星期的暑假了。

en.t: Now, in the new surroundings that lay before me, only a few weeks of summer vacation remained.

units.source_text: 这是我服丧期间的暑期。

en.t: This was the summer of my mourning period.

units.source_text: 时值1944年，即战争末期，是个不可思议的宁静的暑期……

en.t: It was 1944, the final stage of the war, and it was an unbelievably quiet summer...

units.source_text: 寺庙的弟子过着纪律严格的生活。

en.t: The temple disciples lived under strict discipline.

units.source_text: 对我来说，这似是最后的。

en.t: To me, this seemed to be the last one.

units.source_text: 我还仔细地倾听着那蝉鸣声。

en.t: I was still listening intently to that sound of the cicadas.
